title: Mastery pool (contract v1)
$comment: Applies to every seed whose file stem ends in _mastery, and to any pool a lesson's quiz scene points at. It is a pool (pool.schema.json) plus the structural facts of the 20-item mastery test. Answer-key spread, difficulty mix and explanation quality are authoring-quality rules enforced by vcheck.js and addlesson.sh, not by this schema.
